experiments.name: staggered-scroll-resume
experiments.hypothesis: Staggering post-scroll video play() calls would reduce resume burst long frames.
experiments.decision: Rolled back because it was worse than immediate resume.

experiments.name: compact-three-video-cap
experiments.hypothesis: Reducing compact normal playback from four videos to three would reduce decode pressure and long frames.
experiments.decision: Rolled back because it worsened timing and reduced visible motion.

conclusion: The best current measured configuration remains the previous imperative scroll-pause setup. Do not reintroduce staggered resume or reduce compact normal to three videos without new evidence.
